paragraphs: Rav Zuti. Rav Zuti of Rav Pappi’s house recited: “Vows are annulled only for the Sabbath’s need”: Nedarim chapter 10, 77,beginning of side a. In Shabbat 157a the same teaching on vows appears. In a separate discussion they asked: “If he married, must he divorce?” Rav Kahana says he divorces; Rav Ashi says he does not. Rav Zuti of Rav Pappi’s house taught them according to the view “If he married, he does not divorce,” in Yevamot 25,end of side b. Under resh, among the Rav names, Yuchasin writes: “Zuti of Rav Pappi’s house, end of Shabbat; Rashi reads Rabbi Abba Zuti, Hakometz 15b.” It has no basis, for he lists Abba Zuti under alef and Rav Zuti under resh.
